purpose: Allow/deny CDEadmin commands by module, risk and profile.

states.default: AI Tool Policy is ready and shows the selected/active content.
states.loading: Keep shell and current selection visible; use Skeleton/Progress; disable commands requiring completed data.
states.empty: Show a purpose-specific empty state for AI Tool Policy with the single valid create/select/configure action; never blank canvas.
states.error: Show persistent diagnostic in Problems plus inline summary and recovery/retry where safe; authored data is preserved.
states.permission: Show permission denied separately from unavailable/unsupported; expose safe reason and request/escalation action where defined.
states.disconnected_or_stale: Preserve last safe result as visibly stale when permitted; disable live mutation until refreshed/reconnected.

keyboard: Ctrl/Cmd+1 Explorer; Ctrl/Cmd+2 Workbench; Ctrl/Cmd+3 Inspector; Ctrl/Cmd+4 Bottom Drawer. Tab follows region order. Tree/grid use arrows. Enter opens/activates. Shift+F10/context key opens actions. No unregistered global shortcut.
pointer: Single click selects; double click only invokes registered default open. Drag/drop only on documented semantic target. Splitters use standard hit area. No destructive mutation on drop.
persistence: AI session/policy definitions persist through Project/AI authorities; raw credentials and large tool results do not. Layout is device-local.
multi_window: May detach only through ToolRegistry/WorkspaceHost when the surface capability allows. Detached surfaces share authoritative backend/project state and do not create a private store.
accessibility: Critical content has text/tree/table alternative. Visible focus, high contrast, Low Vision, Motor Assistance, Reduced Motion, non-drag alternatives. Streaming/live updates do not steal focus.
functional_regression: Uses cdeadmin_ui semantic components rather than provider/module-owned renderer imports.
Uses TaskService for continuing background work.
Preserves ResourceRef/AssetRef identity and provider-native semantics.
Does not serialize raw secrets in asset, layout, ToolDescriptor, audit export, or AI context.
AI uses a dedicated connector/principal, never the current human database session.
ScratchBird compatibility access remains sandboxed; cross-surface is SBsql-only when authorized.
